_meta.role: Co-Op, Robotics Skills for Automating Science

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) with hands-on robotics software experience spanning ROS 2 manipulation, motion planning, and the boundary between software and physical hardware. Built and debugged vision-guided pick-and-place skills on physical UR5e and AL5B arms, validated motion plans against MoveIt/RViz, and integrated robotic behaviors end to end across sensors, actuators, and embedded controllers. Strong in Python and C++ with a track record of shipping well-tested code and iterating quickly on real hardware.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal surface inspection pipeline for microscopic crack analysis, combining custom image stitching, wavelet denoising, and monocular depth estimation on physical inspection hardware.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end to end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth, translating 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (UR5e & AL5B)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place trajectories on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; AL5B repeatability measured at <2 mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system achieving 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency; debugged 11 integration failures on physical hardware (false detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture).
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing (5.2x speedup vs eager PyTorch) and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping via a TCA9548A I2C mux.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Delivery Drone
bullets: Architected a distributed robotics stack — Flask/Socket.IO server, Jetson Orin Nano (ROS 2 Humble), and Arduino flight controller over Bluetooth — for voice-activated autonomous flight.

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
